During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Schnil Hakoon/Legends|Schnil Hakoon]] maintained a '''headquarters''' on the planet [[Kirtania]]. The thief [[Pierce Mantrell]] broke into the building and stole the [[Amber Eye]].
